data_role: s20_val (32 windows, seed 20261021) - selection only, never blind
rule_stated_a_priori: Among candidates at matched critical-path depth, the one with the lowest mean delta_nll on s20_val advances.
One representative per depth is carried to the blind test, forming the depth curve.
Deletion controls (del-w*) are carried as a control axis, not as DAG candidates.
No candidate is added, dropped or re-ranked after the blind splits are measured.

28.note: reference: full-chain DAG reproduces the original model bit-exactly

27.note: same depth and same 1 missed update; pair position is worth ~0.024 nats spread, ordering matches the per-edge probe cost (0.0300 < 0.0377 < 0.0433)

25.note: same depth and 3 missed updates; contiguous pairing in front is not worse than shifted pairing

24.note: contiguous even pairing is miss-minimal at this depth and wins; non-contiguous alignment with the same level sizes is worse despite a similar miss count; a size-3 level (mix4) is worse than both

del-w1.note: same depth as pair-mid but one block fewer executed: 0.1001 vs 0.0300, the two axes stay separate

sparse-x1.reason: 80 missed updates in the window; collapses the model

headline_claim_to_test: No sparse or non-contiguous DAG beats the fixed contiguous grouping at matched critical-path depth; quality is essentially a function of depth (and, secondarily, of how the missed updates are distributed).
note: Selection used s20_val only. The blind splits were not opened before this file was written.
